title: 第138章 同仇敌忾第137章 西方教主最后的哀嚎
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第138章同仇敌忾！
当准提的意识也彻底陷入混沌，与他的师兄接引一样，变成一具空有圣人之躯的行尸走肉时，整个三界都陷入了一种诡异的寂静。
所有目睹了这一切的生灵心中都百感交集。
可怜吗？
或许有一点。
毕竟是两位曾经高高在上的圣人，如今却落得如此凄惨的下场。
但更多的人心中却只有两个字。
活该！
顾长青最后的那番话点醒了所有人。
西方二圣的失败，不是因为他们出身不好，也不是因为他们运气太差。
而是因为他们从骨子里就充满了对底层生灵的蔑视和不信任。
他们宁愿把希望寄托在虚无缥缈的“天道”和“功德”之上，也不愿意相信自己脚下那片土地和土地上那些充满了无限可能的人民。
这样的人，这样的道统，它的败亡是注定的。
天界废墟之上，通天教主长长地叹了一口气。
“人定胜天……说得好啊！”
他看着顾长青的背影，眼神中充满了发自内心的钦佩。
“我以前总觉得我那‘截取一线生机’的道已经够离经叛道了。现在看来，跟你这直接要‘逆天改命’的道比起来，还是差得远了。”
元始天尊也默默地点了点头。
他看着下方那片生机勃勃的昆仑界，看着那些虽然渺小但却充满了自信和活力的凡人。
他第一次如此清晰地感受到了那股名为“众生之力”的磅礴伟力。

他终于明白自己以前错得有多离谱。
他所谓的“顺天应人”，顺的不过是鸿钧一个人的“天”。
而顾长青顺的，才是这天地间亿万万生灵的“人”！
孰高孰下，一目了然。
“顾道友，这二人如今神魂已灭，只余空壳，你打算如何处置？”
太上老君看着地上那两具圣人躯壳，缓缓开口问道。
圣人之躯乃是大道本源所化，不死不灭，与这方世界紧密相连。
若是处理不好，强行将其摧毁，很可能会引起世界本源的动荡，得不偿失。
所有人的目光都再次聚焦在了顾长青的身上。
大家都很想知道他会如何处理这三界之中最后的两个“历史遗留问题”。
顾长青看了一眼地上那两具躯壳，脸上露出了一抹意味深长的笑容。
“圣人之躯乃是天地间最精纯的能量聚合体，就这么毁了，确实有些浪费。”
他顿了顿，目光扫过三界六道，声音再次变得庄严而又肃穆。
“朕以人道之名，在此立下永恒法旨！”
他的声音化作了金色的法则神链，融入到这方世界的每一个角落！
“其一！”
“西方教，其道已证为‘寄生之道’，其教义乃是禁锢众生思想、扼杀文明活力的‘精神毒瘤’！”
“自今日起，西方教义在三界六大之中被列为‘禁法’！”
“凡有生灵敢再修此法，人道法则将自动剥夺其所有修为，打入凡尘，永世不得修行！”
“凡有生灵敢再传此道，人道法则将自动禁其言、封其口，使其永世不得发声！”

轰隆隆——！
随着顾长青的法旨下达，整个洪荒世界都为之响应！
天地间的法则被强行改写！
content_en:
Chapter 138: Shared hatred!
When Zhunti's consciousness completely fell into chaos, and like his senior brother Jie Yin, he turned into a walking corpse with the body of a saint, the entire three worlds fell into a strange silence.
All the creatures who witnessed all this had mixed feelings in their hearts.
Is it pitiful?
Maybe a little.
After all, they were two saints who were once high and mighty, but now they have ended up in such a miserable end.
But more people only have two words in their hearts.
Deserve it!
Gu Changqing's last words woke everyone up.
The failure of the Second Saints of the West was not because of their poor backgrounds, nor was it because of their bad luck.
It's because they are filled with contempt and distrust of the lower-class creatures from their very bones.
They would rather place their hopes on the illusory "way of heaven" and "merits" than believe in the land under their feet and the people on it who are full of infinite possibilities.
Such people and orthodoxy are destined to fail.
On top of the ruins of Heaven Realm, the leader of Tongtian Cult let out a long sigh.
"Man can conquer heaven...that's so well said!"
He looked at Gu Changqing's back, his eyes filled with heartfelt admiration.
"I used to think that my way of 'intercepting a glimmer of life' was already deviant enough. Now it seems that it is still far behind compared to your way of 'going against nature and changing one's fate'."
Yuanshi Tianzun also nodded silently.
He looked at the vibrant Kunlun world below, and at the mortals who were small but full of confidence and vitality.
For the first time, he felt so clearly the majestic power called "the power of all living beings".
He finally understood how wrong he had been.
What he calls "submitting to heaven and responding to people" is nothing more than Hongjun's "heaven".
And Gu Changqing Shun is the "person" of the billions of creatures in this world!
Which one is higher and which one is lower is clear at a glance.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, the souls of these two people have been destroyed now, leaving only empty shells. What do you plan to do with them?"
Taishang Laojun looked at the two saint bodies on the ground and asked slowly.
The body of the saint is transformed from the origin of the great road, is immortal, and is closely connected with this world.
If it is not handled well and forcibly destroyed, it is likely to cause turmoil in the origin of the world, and the gain outweighs the loss.
Everyone's eyes were focused on Gu Changqing again.
Everyone wants to know how he will deal with the last two "historical issues" among the three realms.
Gu Changqing glanced at the two bodies on the ground, and a meaningful smile appeared on his face.
"The body of a saint is the purest energy aggregate in the world. It is indeed a waste to be destroyed like this."
He paused, his eyes swept across the Three Realms and Six Paths, and his voice became solemn and solemn again.
"In the name of humanity, I hereby establish an eternal decree!"
His voice turned into a golden chain of laws, integrating into every corner of this world!
"One of them!"
"Western religion, its way has been proved to be the 'parasitic way', and its teachings are a 'spiritual cancer' that imprisons the thoughts of all living beings and stifles the vitality of civilization!"
"From today on, Western teachings are classified as 'forbidden law' in the six major realms of the Three Realms!"
"Any living being who dares to practice this method will automatically be deprived of all their cultivation by the laws of humanity, and will be thrown into the mortal world, and will never be able to practice again!"
"Any living being who dares to spread this teaching will automatically be silenced and silenced by the laws of humanity, so that they will not be able to speak out forever!"
Rumble——!
As Gu Changqing's decree was issued, the entire prehistoric world responded!
The laws of heaven and earth have been forcibly rewritten!
